normativeLanguage.MUST: Required; violation is a blocker or major finding according to quality-gates.json.
normativeLanguage.MUST_NOT: Prohibited; violation is a blocker or major finding according to quality-gates.json.
normativeLanguage.SHOULD: Expected; an exception requires a recorded product or technical rationale.

uiBase.inventory: The installed llms.txt is the component inventory and API reference; this bundle does not duplicate it.
uiBase.naming: Component names and composition patterns follow shadcn/ui conventions, so that familiar structure applies. Every component and API still comes from @gears-frontx/ui-kit; shadcn is not a dependency and must never be imported directly.

compositionResponsibilities: table filters, pagination, selection, and inspectors
dashboard widget grids and evidence drill-down
empty, error, restricted, loading, and partial states
sourcePrecedence: Approved product requirements and design references
Installed FrontX manifests and UI-kit documentation
Installed application behavior and existing screens
requiredQualities: Primary user job and next action are evident
Installed components and semantic tokens are reused
Spacing follows the installed 4 px scale and the 8 px primary rhythm
Wide, medium and narrow transformations are declared
Applicable loading, empty, partial, error, restricted, pending and success states exist
Keyboard, focus, names, semantics, contrast, reflow and reduced motion are addressed
Typography, icons, color and motion form one coherent system
Dense data remains readable and has sorting, pagination, evidence and drill-down when applicable
Review findings cite a stable rule ID, location, impact and correction

fallbackPolicy.useWhen: The installed product does not define an equivalent layout or composition rule. Token roles have no bundle fallback: derive a missing value from an installed token (for example via color-mix), or raise the gap with the UI-kit owner instead of inventing a value.
never: Override an installed token with a bundle fallback
Copy an external design system visual theme
Create a second component, color, type, icon, radius or shadow system

prohibited: Duplicating a UI-kit component with ad-hoc markup
Hardcoding a visual value when a semantic token exists
Using color as the only status signal
Adding decorative cards, gradients, helper text or metrics to fill space
Inventing product features, permissions or destructive behavior
Representing responsive behavior as uniform scaling
Using motion without a functional purpose or reduced-motion behavior
Claiming automated, accessibility or visual validation that was not run
